card.title: Sony Dualshock 4 not connecting/charging through USB

source.title: Sony Dualshock 4 not connecting/charging through USB

symptoms: won't charge or sync over USB

claims.statement: DualShock 4 not connecting/charging via USB: check the USB port and ribbon, an open fuse (charging) or a shorted D+/D- protection part (data) on the USB board.

procedure: Check fuse continuity and D+/D- protection part.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
